slot.brief: Count the number of onto (surjective) functions from a set of m elements to a set of n elements using the inclusion–exclusion formula; small numbers.

stem: A controller assigns each of six distinct data streams to one of three distinct servers. How many assignments use every server?

verdicts.working: By inclusion–exclusion, assignments using every server = 3^6 − 3·2^6 + 3 = 540.

working:
$3^6-\binom{3}{1}2^6+\binom{3}{2}1^6=729-192+3=540$

Independent check: By inclusion–exclusion, assignments using every server = 3^6 − 3·2^6 + 3 = 540.
solution:
By inclusion–exclusion, subtract assignments that omit at least one server:
$$3^6-\binom{3}{1}2^6+\binom{3}{2}1^6=729-192+3=540$$
